select v.* from (select hm.bp_id, hm.bp_code, hm.bp_class, hm.bp_name, hm.regno, hm.bp_category, (select bc.description from hls_bp_category bc where bc.bp_category = hm.bp_category) bp_category_n, (select max(ma.bp_attachment_id) from bp_master_attachment ma where ma.bp_id = hm.bp_id) bp_attachment_id, t.record_id, t.company_phone, t.agent_name, t.agent_phone, t.agent_id_card_no, t.legal_name, t.legal_phone, t.legal_id_card_no, t.legal_sign_id, t.check_time, t.open_time, t.legal_open_time, to_char(trunc(to_date(t.check_time, 'yyyyMMddHH24miss')), 'yyyy-mm-dd') check_time_format, to_char(trunc(to_date(t.open_time, 'yyyyMMddHH24miss')), 'yyyy-mm-dd') open_time_format, to_char(trunc(to_date(t.legal_open_time, 'yyyyMMddHH24miss')), 'yyyy-mm-dd') legal_open_time_format, nvl(t.sign_check_status, 'N') sign_check_status, (SELECT sv.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v sv WHERE sv.CODE = 'ANXINSIGN_CHECK_STATUS' AND sv.code_value = nvl(t.sign_check_status, 'N')) sign_check_status_n, t.sign_enabled_flag, t.sign_id, t.operate_user_id, (Select wm_concat(hm1.bp_name) From hls_bp_master_relation t1, hls_bp_master_relation t2, hls_bp_master hm1 Where t1.bp_id = hm.bp_id And t1.relation_type = 'VENDER' And t2.bp_id = t1.related_bp_id And t2.relation_type = 'MANUFACTURER' And hm1.bp_id = t2.related_bp_id) vender_name, (select su.description from sys_user su where su.user_id = t.operate_user_id) operate_user_id_n, (select fu.unit_name from sys_user_allocation sa, fnd_employee_assigns fa, fnd_org_unit fu where sa.user_id = t.operate_user_id and fa.employee_assign_id = sa.employee_assign_id and fu.unit_id = fa.unit_id and fa.primary_position_flag = 'Y') unit_name from prj_cert_record t right join hls_bp_master hm on hm.bp_id = t.bp_id where exists (select * from hls_bp_master_role hr where hr.bp_id = hm.bp_id and hr.bp_category = 'DEALER') or (hm.bp_class = 'ORG' and exists (select * from hls_bp_master_role hr where hr.bp_id = hm.bp_id and hr.bp_category in ('DEALER', 'TENANT', 'MANUFACTURER', 'VENDER')))) v
and nvl(v.anxinsign_enabled_flag,'N') = #{anxinsignEnabledFlag}
and v.anxinsign_id like concat(concat('%',#{anxinsignId}),'%')
and v.legal_anxinsign_id like concat(concat('%',#{legalAnxinsignId}),'%')
and v.bp_code like concat(concat('%',#{bpCode}),'%')
and v.bp_name like concat(concat('%',#{bpName}),'%')
and v.agent_name like concat(concat('%',#{agentName}),'%')
and v.vender_name like concat(concat('%',#{venderName}),'%')
and to_date(v.check_time_format,'yyyy-mm-dd') >= to_date(#{checkTimeFrom},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and to_date(v.check_time_format,'yyyy-mm-dd') <= to_date(#{checkTimeTo},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and to_date(v.open_time_format,'yyyy-mm-dd') >= to_date(#{openTimeFrom},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and to_date(v.open_time_format,'yyyy-mm-dd') <= to_date(#{openTimeTo},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and to_date(v.legal_open_time_format,'yyyy-mm-dd') >= to_date(#{legalOpenTimeFrom},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and to_date(v.legal_open_time_format,'yyyy-mm-dd') <= to_date(#{leaglOpenTimeTo},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and nvl(v.anxinsign_check_status,'N') = #{anxinsignCheckStatus}
order by v.bp_code desc
select * from yx_anxinsign_record t where t.bp_id = to_number(#{bpId})
select * from yx_anxinsign_record t,sys_user su where t.bp_id = su.bp_id and su.user_id = to_number(#{userId})
select t.ip from sys_user_login t where t.login_id = (select max(l.login_id) from sys_user_login l where l.user_id = #{userId})
